verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਰੋਗੀ ਆਵਤ ਹੈਂ ਬੈਦ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਜੈਸੋ ਜੈਸੋ ਰੋਗ ਤੈਸੋ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਖੁਵਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau anek rogee aavat hai(n) baidh gireh jaiso jaiso rog taiso aaukhadh khuvaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as several patients come to the house of a medical practitioner, and he administers medicine to each one of them according to their ailment.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜ ਦ੍ਵਾਰ ਲੋਗ ਆਵਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਮਿਤ ਜੋਈ ਜਾਹੀਂ ਜੋਗ ਤੈਸੀ ਟਹਿਲ ਬਤਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise raaj dhavaiaar log aavat sevaa namit joiee jaahee(n) jog taisee Tahil bataaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as myriad people come to the door of the king to serve him, and each one is told to prefer service that he is capable and fit to do;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਸ ਜਨ ਅਰਥੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਆਵੈਂ ਜੋਈ ਜੋਈ ਜਾਚੈ ਦੇ ਦੇ ਦੁਖਨ ਮਿਟਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise dhaataa paas jan arathee anek aavai(n) joiee joiee jaachai dhe dhe dhukhan miTaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as many needy persons come to a kind-hearted donor and he gives them whatever each one asks, thus allaying distress of each one of them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਨ ਆਵਤ ਹੈਂ ਅਨੇਕ ਸਿਖ ਜੈਸੋ ਜੈਸੋ ਭਾਉ ਤੈਸੀ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਪੁਜਾਵਈ ॥੬੭੪॥
verses.translit_en: taise gur saran aavat hai(n) anek sikh jaiso jaiso bhaau taisee kaamanaa pujaaviee ||674||

en.bdb: Similarly many Sikhs come into the refuge of the True Guru, and whatever devotion and love one has in the mind the , True Guru fulfils it accordingly.  (674)
